items.title: Grover Mitchell interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, Florida, February 13, 1996
items.q: Yeah, well we called him the “Field Marshall” and the “Burgermeister.” ... He was great.

ctx.x: They call it “Straw Boss.” © Fillius Jazz Archive -8-
Yeah, well we called him the “Field Marshall” and the “Burgermeister.” That was his whole attitude and everything. But he could back it up. Yeah. He was great.
Everybody seemed to get nicknames along the way.
